findings.title: Missing node_modules dependencies for 3D MineCast view in HMI frontend
findings.description: The 3D MineCast view inside the HMI (mine-cast.html / ControlRoom3DTwin.tsx) imports @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, and three. These were added to package.json in recent commits but npm install was not run in the frontend directory, causing Vite pre-transform errors (504 Outdated Optimize Dep / Failed to resolve import).
findings.evidence: Vite server logs when navigating to http://localhost:5173/mine-cast.html show 'Failed to resolve import @react-three/drei from src/controlRoom/ControlRoom3DTwin.tsx'.
findings.impact: The 3D MineCast tab crashes upon click during a live demo if opened in the browser.
findings.remediation: Run 'npm install' in SYNQRA_SIH2026-27-HMI/frontend once the audit phase concludes.

findings.category: Safety Watchdog vs Bench Demo Conflict
findings.title: Firmware fails open to continuous forward rotation on timeout, violating fail-closed safety rule
findings.description: To facilitate bench motor spinning demonstrations, VEHICLE_B_TRUCK_02_V2V_DIGITAL_TWIN_MOTOR.ino line 273 was modified to set 'commandedSpeedMs = DEFAULT_SPEED_MS' on timeout instead of 0.0f. This breaks automated test test_firmware_command_timeout_constant_is_intact and violates AGENTS.md Rule 7 (fail-closed safety constraint).
findings.evidence: tests/test_command_gateway.py::test_firmware_command_timeout_constant_is_intact FAILED. Regex pattern for fail-closed speed zeroing failed to match.
findings.impact: A technically competent evaluator inspecting firmware source will note that loss of Wi-Fi causes the vehicle to continue rolling rather than stopping.
findings.remediation: Restore commandedSpeedMs = 0.0f on timeout; use a dedicated non-safety bench-test flag if manual motor testing is needed.

findings.component: fog_safe/road.py vs Standard NMDC Civil Engineering Convention
findings.title: Road grade sign convention inversion in fog_safe (+grade is downhill, -grade is uphill)
findings.description: In fog_safe/road.py line 28, theta is defined as arctan(percent_grade / 100.0) with the explicit comment 'Downhill theta > 0'. However, standard civil engineering and other simulation modules define downhill as negative grade (-8%). Passing -8.0% to fog_safe causes gravity to be treated as an uphill retarder, making stopping distance shorter and safe speed higher (3.56 m/s vs 3.23 m/s on flat). When +8.0% is passed, safe speed correctly drops to 2.76 m/s.
findings.evidence: Observed runtime outputs in scratch/run_hmi_tests.py: grade=-8.0% yields v_safe=3.56 m/s; grade=+8.0% yields v_safe=2.76 m/s.
findings.impact: If an external API or elevation profile feeds negative downhill grades to fog_safe without sign inversion, trucks will be allowed to travel faster downhill than on level ground.
findings.remediation: Standardize grade sign definition across all integration adapters or explicitly document and enforce the sign inversion contract at the adapter boundary.

findings.title: Strict operator authentication enforcement causes unauthenticated automated integration tests to fail
findings.description: The command gateway strictly requires an authenticated operator session token (operator_registry.py). In verify_controlled_integration.py steps 7-8, the test POSTs directly to /api/commands without passing an authentication token, triggering HTTP 403 / [COMMAND DENIED] NO_AUTHENTICATED_OPERATOR, which fails the script even though the underlying safety logic works.
findings.evidence: verify_all_regressions.py output: 'STAGE 3 CONTROLLED INTEGRATION VERIFICATION: FAIL' due to [COMMAND DENIED] operator=None vehicle=TRUCK_01 reason=NO_AUTHENTICATED_OPERATOR.
findings.impact: Automated regression suites report false-negative failures unless an operator session is provisioned.
findings.remediation: Update test fixture to authenticate an operator session before posting dispatch commands.

findings.title: Divergent latency formulation in stopping distance calculations between HMI backend and Predictive Twin
findings.description: Both modules solve quadratic stopping distance equations S_stop = v*tau + v^2/(2*a_dec). However, fog_safe incorporates an adaptive dynamic communication latency margin k_comm * (1 - C_comm) * v into the effective reaction time tau_eff, whereas the Predictive Digital Twin models uses static component latencies (tau_sensor + tau_comm + tau_compute + tau_brake) without the dynamic link quality penalty.
findings.impact: Under identical degraded radio links, the HMI backend safe speed solver is more conservative than the 3D Predictive Twin solver.
findings.remediation: Document the intentional distinction: HMI enforces real-time operational margins while the Predictive Twin simulates average macroscopic cycle times.

findings.title: Physical hardware is currently unverified in the development execution environment
findings.description: No physical ESP32 microcontrollers or physical trucks are connected to the current machine. Firmware exists and compiles, and serial/packet parsing is rigorously tested against emulator records and wire fixtures, but live physical hardware execution has not been verified.
findings.evidence: Classification: NOT PHYSICALLY VERIFIED per Audit Rule 3.
findings.impact: Physical validation cannot be claimed to evaluators without live hardware execution evidence.
findings.remediation: Connect physical bench hardware, flash firmware, and run run_physical_hil_test.py on-site prior to final presentation.

top_5_risks.risk: Failing open on Wi-Fi timeout in TRUCK_02 firmware (DEFAULT_SPEED_MS instead of 0.0f) exposed by judge inspecting code.
Uninstalled frontend dependencies causing 3D MineCast tab to crash with pre-transform error during live presentation.
Grade sign convention clash (+8% vs -8%) leading to inconsistent safe speeds if elevation data is plugged in live.
Claiming real-world physical fleet validation with 50 trucks when only 2 physical prototype RC cars exist.
Evaluator confusion caused by mixing the live operational HMI with the separate 3D predictive simulation twin.

top_5_proofs_to_build.proof: Execute run_physical_hil_test.py with actual physical ESP32 hardware connected and log live oscilloscope / motor tachometer traces.
Run 'npm install' in SYNQRA_SIH2026-27-HMI/frontend and record a smooth browser recording of the 3D MineCast view.
Prove fail-closed safety by cutting ESP32 Wi-Fi mid-drive and demonstrating 100% stop within 2.0 seconds.
Create an automated visual side-by-side comparison of S04 (uncontrolled dense fog) vs S17 (Chance-Constrained MPC) showing queue elimination.
Standardize and test the elevation adapter contract ensuring negative grades from GIS maps correctly map to downhill retarding forces.
